dedupe_keys.name: kincade fire highway vehicle routing data 2019

description: The EvacuationBehavior team publishes anonymized highway vehicle-routing observations around the 2019 Kincade Fire in Sonoma County. The public DesignSafe page links Open Data Commons Attribution terms and the article describes 21,160 records in CSV from 16 October to 13 November 2019. Geohash coordinates represent proxy highway entry and exit locations; individual device identifiers are anonymized. These routes can calibrate evacuation traffic or agent-choice models during wildfire emergencies. A caveat is that proxy geohashes and mobile-device coverage do not show every trip, road segment or resident, and the archive includes pre- and post-fire dates that users must filter. The rejected round-one candidate treated the resource as too study-specific, but its documented trip records support repeatable simulation checks. I read the own DesignSafe metadata, DOI registry and article Data Records without downloading routes, re-identifying devices or testing an evacuation model. No directly related catalogue record was identified.
